usage.trendDescription: The drop between balance readings reflects compute units consumed over time.
usage.emptyBody: The app records quota whenever querying the colab CLI. After some usage, the trend curve will appear here.
usage.totalNote: Total {{spent}} Compute Units{{unreadNote}}{{inferredNote}}; records started at {{start}}.
usage.batchHint: Balances are settled in batches; consumption between readings is amortized over time, so the chart is best viewed at day granularity or above.
usage.noSampleSpan: {{span}} · No samples (not equivalent to zero spend)

settings.sectionAccountDesc: Authorization status, compute unit balance, and spend rate from the colab CLI.
settings.sectionUsageDesc: History recorded from balance readings, amortized between adjacent measurements.
settings.sectionAppearanceDesc: Follow system, or choose interface language and light / dark theme; matching the toggle in the top bar.
settings.sectionTerminalDesc: The terminal's palette, type, cursor and viewport, plus the keyboard and mouse keys that work inside it.
settings.sectionRuntimeDesc: Source and token validity of the colab CLI on this machine.
settings.sectionExternalDesc: Write runtime SSH entries to ~/.ssh/config for external ssh, scp, and editors.
settings.accountEmailDesc: Read from the access token (tokeninfo) — not the field the CLI writes to disk, which is always empty.
settings.accountAcceleratorsDesc: The machine types this account may request; struck-through entries are unavailable and a request would fail.
settings.disclaimer: ColabDesk is an unofficial client and is not affiliated with Google. All networking and authentication are performed by the official colab CLI; the app only invokes and presents results.
settings.appearanceLanguageDesc: Interface language; supports system default, Chinese, and English.
settings.appearanceThemeDesc: Follows OS theme automatically, or lock the interface to light or dark mode.
settings.terminalFontSizeDesc: Applies to all tabs; can also use Ctrl+Shift+= / -
settings.terminalPreviewDesc: Type, colours and breathing room shown here apply to every open terminal in the workbench — nothing reconnects, and nothing running is interrupted.
settings.terminalThemeDesc: A terminal carries a full 16-colour ANSI palette; it decides how remote programs (ls, git, htop) colour their output.
settings.terminalFontDesc: A face the system does not have falls back to the bundled Geist Mono, so the grid never breaks.
settings.terminalLineHeightDesc: More leading reads better in long logs and streaming output.
settings.terminalCursorDesc: A block is the traditional terminal; a bar reads like a modern editor.
settings.terminalCursorBlinkDesc: Off leaves it steady — cleaner for recording or screenshots.
settings.terminalPaddingDesc: The ring between the text and the frame; changing it makes the terminal recompute its columns.
settings.terminalScrollbackDesc: How much history you can scroll up into; lowering it drops the excess at once.
settings.shortcutRightClick: Copy selection if present, otherwise paste
settings.runtimeCliCmdDesc: The app prioritizes bundled runtime before system CLI
settings.externalSshDescActive: Write managed config block for {{session}} for external ssh / scp / VS Code Remote-SSH
settings.externalSshDescInactive: Open a session first before writing its SSH entry

failure.networkInterrupted: Network request interrupted: TLS connection to colab.research.google.com was reset. Retry if sporadic; check proxy/VPN if persistent.
failure.traceback: The colab command raised an exception. See output below for full stack trace.
